d.s: SikaBond INSTANT NAILS FAST is a premium, gap filling, water based, multi purpose construction adhesive providing strong initial grab and high bond strength.
a: Reduces number of mechanical fasteners required to install floors or walls.
May be repositioned for up to 60 minutes after application
Reduces squeaking and nail ride in floors
Fast initial grab for vertical and horizontal positions
us: SikaBond INSTANT NAILS FAST can be used on most substrates due to its excellent adhesion.
Skirting boards, architraves and trims to walls
Bonding panels and sheeting to internal wall studs
Bonding particleboard, plywood, fibre cement and strip flooring to joists
Bonding metal, glass, aluminium,concrete, paper and cork

sec.t: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

The substrate must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, cement laitance, old sealants and poorly bonded coatings which could affect adhesion. All loose flaking material must be removed and light sanding is recommended. SikaBond INSTANT NAILS FAST will adhere to damp (not wet) substrates but drying times may be extended. Substrates should be above 5°C. Do not bond 2 non-porous substrates ensure that one surface is porous.
Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin use detergent and water.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Materials to avoid
storage.text: No special restrictions on storage with other products.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: For personal protection see section 8. No special handling advice required. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
